items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: and lo and behold the next time he showed up with Count Basie and that was it.

ctx.x: Oh, Lester was a big, carefree country boy. He used to walk around New York with his saxophone under

his arm, in no case. So I told him, you know, I'd say, "Hey, man, you've got to get a case for that horn. Nobody under walks around with a horn / his arm." You know. Without a case. And he -- you know, and he was a funny fellow, because the expressions he used to use and the things that were funny to him, and just his habits in general. He was just a big country boy, you know. But I guess then he went back to Kansas City, and lo and behold the next time he showed up with Count Basie and that was it.
